name: Cote d'Ivoire
summary: West African agricultural power leading world cocoa production. Balances domestic natural gas power generation with Sassandra and Bandama river hydroelectric stations.

pm25.name: Annual Mean PM2.5 Exposure
pm25.source_dataset: State of Global Air (SOGA) 2024 / Global Burden of Disease
pm25.context: 8.52x the WHO 2021 annual guideline (5 µg/m³); dense Abidjan transport corridor emissions and seasonal savanna fires.

temp_anomaly.name: Surface Temperature Anomaly
temp_anomaly.context: Relative to 1951-1980 baseline; cocoa belt vulnerable to shifting rainy season precipitation onset.

temp_trend.name: 30-Year Warming Trend Rate
temp_trend.context: Equatorial West African warming trend rate over 1994-2023 trailing three decades.

co2_total.name: Total Territorial Fossil CO2
co2_total.context: 0.04% share of global emissions; offshore natural gas fields fuel coastal thermal stations.

co2_per_capita.name: Per Capita Fossil CO2
co2_per_capita.context: Low per capita footprint; rural populations primarily rely on biomass cooking energy.

forest_share.name: Forest Cover Fraction
forest_share.source_dataset: Global Forest Resources Assessment via World Bank (AG.LND.FRST.ZS)
forest_share.context: Historical tropical rainforest area ~28,000 km²; cocoa agroforestry replanting programs underway.

renewables_share.name: Renewable Share of Electricity
renewables_share.context: Soubré and Buyo hydroelectric dams supply roughly one-third of national electricity.

population.name: Total Population & Density
population.context: Arithmetic population density of 91 people/km²; urban population fraction is 52.6%.
